title: Sriracha Baozi Filling
description: A spicy twist on traditional baozi filling, featuring sriracha-marinated pork.

ingredients.name: pork
ingredients.notes: boneless pork shoulder or pork belly

instructions: Preheat a steamer or Instant Pot to cook the baozi.
In a large bowl, whisk together warm water, sriracha, and 5-spice powder.
Add the pork to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a pan over medium-high heat and cook the marinated pork until browned.
Roll out the baozi dough into balls and flatten slightly.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each baozi dough.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Cook the baozi in a steamer or Instant Pot according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Serve the sriracha baozi hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
